V1.reason: At least one sensitivity source could not be constructed or did not meet the projection threshold.

V2.scope: Measured HI/H2 unchanged except geometry and one CO factor; synthetic mass exceptions tested separately.

V3.interpretation: segmented quadrature under separately approved model-only amendment

V3b.scope: Both orders on every primary-source V3 case, not sensitivity variants.

blockers: V5: at least one source sensitivity is incomplete

numerical_method.radial: order-n Gauss-Legendre independently on each finite source interval; split at 0, every aligned profile ring centre, each field radius inside the support, and the frozen outer cutoff
numerical_method.vertical: frozen rational half-line map with order-n Gauss-Legendre nodes
numerical_method.order_comparison: n=64 versus n=128 on every radial panel and in z
numerical_method.change_control: approved v1 amendment for model-only validation; no fit authorized

provenance.note: Source hashes, not HEAD alone, identify this implementation.

sparc.loader: the certified load_sparc primary selection used by candidate-a-option2-sparc-baryonic-v1

parent_protocol.unchanged_definition: rho_eff = rho0 (rho_bar / rho0)^(1/alpha) applied after summing stellar, HI and H2 volume densities; nabla^2 Phi = 4 pi G rho_eff; V_c^2 = R dPhi/dR at z = 0 from the full source; no second helium factor

numerical_method_status: Approved separately versioned method for model-only validation; no fit is authorized.
